reading.title: Scorpio Sun Squares Mars
overview: The Sun at 28 Scorpio squares Mars at 27 Leo with an orb of 0.08 degrees while the Moon at 25 Pisces moves toward a trine with the Sun. Mars conjoins Jupiter at 26 Leo and both square the Sun, with Venus in its rulership at 24 Libra sextile to both. These configurations occur against Uranus retrograde at 4 Gemini trine Pluto at 3 Aquarius and Neptune retrograde at 2 Aries sextile Pluto.

Mundane tradition associates a Sun-Mars square with tensions between leaders and assertive actions, while Mars-Jupiter conjunctions point to expansive campaigns. Uranus-Pluto aspects are read as periods of structural upheaval, and the current lunation at 17 Scorpio falls in the third house for the United States and the twelfth for Russia, Ukraine and Israel.
Saturn remains retrograde in its fall at 8 Aries and Pluto stays out of bounds in Aquarius. The next lunation events and stations listed in the almanac fall after the current date.

nations.reading: Transiting Neptune opposes the Sibly MC by 0.9 degrees and the Sun squares the natal Moon by 0.38 degrees. Mars and Jupiter both oppose the natal Moon within one degree. These placements coincide with reporting on possible shifts in aid policy but show no measured departure from chance in historical tests of lunar or Mars effects on alerts.

Transiting Pluto opposes the natal Moon by 1.0 degree and Mars conjoins the natal Mars by 0.83 degrees. The Sun squares natal Mars by 0.76 degrees. Reporting on Hezbollah sites and confiscated materials aligns with the Mars-Jupiter conjunction but records show Mars afflictions perform no better than chance against missile-alert data.

Transiting Uranus opposes natal Jupiter by 0.64 degrees and Saturn squares the natal Sun by 1.06 degrees. Jupiter squares natal Venus by 0.39 degrees. Election-related market questions appear in the overlaps with Uranus-Pluto and Neptune-Pluto aspects.

Transiting Pluto conjoins natal Saturn by 1.83 degrees and Neptune sextiles natal Saturn by 0.24 degrees. Mars and Jupiter both conjoin natal Mercury and Venus within 1.5 degrees. The lunation sits in the twelfth house; historical tests find Mars and full-moon periods no better than chance against air-raid data.

reading.lore_and_intel: Sun square Mars and Mars-Jupiter conjunction overlap with reporting on security pacts and missile-site strikes in the Middle East at z-values above 4. Uranus trine Pluto and Neptune sextile Pluto overlap with Taiwan election markets and consent-law stories at z-values above 4. Venus sextile Jupiter overlaps with coalition signals at z 3.6. Neptune opposition to the US MC shows weaker z-values near 1.1 with aid-policy items. No overlaps appear with North Korea or Iran transits in the supplied reporting.

watch.note: Jupiter stations retrograde and Neptune stations direct

reading.the_test: Records over thousands of days show Mars afflictions perform no better than chance against Ukraine air-raid alarms, Israel alerts and Russian losses. Full moons and eclipses likewise show no departure from chance against the same series and worldwide magnitude-6 earthquakes. The tests report differences of -5 percent to +35 percent with all corrected p-values at or above 0.86.
